definitions.explanation: A device used to measure physical quantities such as temperature, pressure, distance, or weight. Covers a broad range from simple gauges to sophisticated electronic instruments.

examples.japanese: {計測器|けいそくき}の{精度|せいど}を{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: Check the accuracy of the measuring instrument.

examples.japanese: この{計測器|けいそくき}は{温度|おんど}と{湿度|しつど}を{同時|どうじ}に{測|はか}れる。
examples.english: This measuring instrument can measure temperature and humidity simultaneously.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{計測器|けいそくき}を{導入|どうにゅう}したことで、{検査|けんさ}{時間|じかん}が{大幅|おおはば}に{短縮|たんしゅく}された。
examples.english: By introducing new measuring instruments, inspection time was significantly reduced.

notes:
A compound of {計測|けいそく} (measurement) and {器|き} (instrument, device). Used broadly in scientific, industrial, and technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {計測器|けいそくき}の{精度|せいど}: accuracy of a measuring instrument
- {計測器|けいそくき}を{校正|こうせい}する: to calibrate a measuring instrument
- {計測器|けいそくき}メーカー: measuring instrument manufacturer
- {電子|でんし}{計測器|けいそくき}: electronic measuring instrument

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {測定器|そくていき}: measuring device — largely synonymous but slightly more common in everyday technical use
- {計器|けいき}: gauge, meter — typically refers to instruments built into equipment (dashboards, cockpits)
- センサー: sensor — detects a specific physical quantity but may not display the reading directly
